Maximum10, current2/history4(max2each)/selectedheader4. At least1sec between launches. No redirects/retries/cache refetch/endpoints/UA/IP rotation. transport_stop: 403/429 or challenge on wire or successfully decoded gzip body stops that host under same lock; subsequent calls record no_request, not another HTTP. Preserve raw wire bytes/SHA and HTTP headers/status. HTTP200 is not source qualification.
response_bound: Fixed16MiB metadata/header response limit; partial oversized raw retained with gap. Accept-Encoding identity requested; if gzip returned, decode and recheck challenge. No filing-body endpoint or text counting is implemented.
paging: Use full declared ordered nonoverlapping catalog including recent. Unique containing range first, then at most one direct adjacent page according to missing annual direction. Strict anchor gap uses successor then only its direct predecessor; needing another successor is gap. Verify exact declared min/max filingDate/count. Unread range capable of intervening prevents qualification. Natural no-filing date gaps are not missing-record proof. No third history page.
annual_pair: Original10-K only: earliest provisional accepted on/after2019-11-26 before2023 and immediate preceding distinct original annual. Preserve amendments separately, never substitute. Reject transitions/duplicate periods/coverage ambiguity.350..380day inclusive report-end difference is fixed metadata consistency only, not full financial period or historical shareclass proof; no calendar-year+1 condition. Header-disproved order/cutoff/form/period means gap, no reselection.
header_identity: Exactly one FILER section; that filer CIK/name/form must agree with selected provisionalCIK/NPORTanchor name and submissions original accession/form/report/filedate. Summer/ambiguous/mismatch remains unknown, never try alternate offsets. Effective date=max(filed,validated acceptance civil day); first archived session strictly later,09:29NY. Not exact publication or firstreceipt.
version: Separate metadata_version_status and body_first_vintage_status. LateDATEASOFCHANGE/explicitPAC is unresolved metadata provenance, not proof of body mutation. failure: Same actual Recorder retains exception/state, current HTTP_state with reserved attempts, all acquired raw responses and receipts, statusFAILED. Exclusive run_state blocks automaticretry. qualification: All four prescribed headers must qualify before producing four proposed bodyURLs; C still separately reviewed/authorized. Failure preserves four slots/selectedCIKs and does not change issuer/pair. No dictionary/wordcounts/bodyfeatures/PIT/model qualification.
